This place is more of a joke than a clinic.

I’ve been calling every morning for over a week, sometimes waiting over an hour on hold, only to be told: “No appointments today, call back tomorrow!”

Every day the same answer. Every day “tomorrow.” Do you really think people’s time and nerves don’t matter? If you say “tomorrow” every day, then when exactly will you offer any appointment? This means there’s effectively no service at all.

This is not a clinic. It’s a useless call center that offers no solutions. How can you call yourselves a clinic when you don’t have a single appointment for patients? My wife needed urgent care, but we’ve been passed around for over a week.

This neglect and incompetence is dangerous. People’s health is not a game. I intend to file a formal complaint with NHS Wales and the relevant oversight bodies.

If you value your health and time, stay far away from here.",null,[0,148]]]],[null,1691397648000000,1691397648000000,"2 years ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/4872689742408076423/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTndlRmxYU2paQlJSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/4872689742408076423/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTndlRmxYU2paQlJSQUIQAA%3D%3D"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/4872689742408076423/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTndlRmxYU2paQlJSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/4872689742408076423/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTndlRmxYU2paQlJSQUIQAA%3D%3D"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/4872689742408076423/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTndlRmxYU2paQlJSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/4872689742408076423/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTndlRmxYU2paQlJSQUIQAA%3D%3D"],null,["en"],[["Hi, sorry to hear these are your views.
